BOOK ONE · LESSON 106

I want you/him/her/them to ... Tell him/her/them to ...

我要你/他/她/他们…… 告诉他/她/他们……

A picture lesson about the difference between 'I want you/him/her/them to...' and 'Tell him/her/them to...'. 16 pictures show people in various situations. The lesson covers positive and negative forms of 'want/tell + object + to + verb'.

106 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Lesson 106: I want you/him/her/them to ... Tell him/her/them to ...

第106课：我要你/他/她/他们…… 告诉他/她/他们……

Listen and answer the questions. Use 'I want you/him/her/them to...' or 'Tell him/her/them to...' to describe what the people in the pictures say and do.

听录音并回答问题。用'I want you/him/her/them to...'或'Tell him/her/them to...'描述图中人们说和做的事。

Listen and answer the questions

Look at the pictures and answer the questions using 'I want you/him/her/them to...' or 'Tell him/her/them to...'.

看图并回答问题，使用'I want you/him/her/them to...'或'Tell him/her/them to...'。

Each picture shows a person in a specific situation. Use 'I want/tell + object + to + verb' to describe the situation.

New words & expressions 生词和短语

carry /'kæri/
v. 带
keep /kiːp/
v. 保存，保留
correct /kə'rekt/
v. 改正，纠正

Written exercises A: Rewrite as statements with infinitives

Rewrite these sentences. Example: Please repair it. → I want you to repair it.

模仿例句将以下祈使句改写成带有动词不定式的陈述句。例句：请修理它。→ 我让你修理它。

Convert each imperative sentence to a statement using 'I want you to + verb'.

Written exercises B: Write questions and answers

Write questions and answers. Example: Type it again! → What do you want me to do? I want you to type it again.

模仿例句改写以下句子。例句：重打一遍！→ 你要我做什么？我让你重打一遍。

Write a question 'What do you want me to do?' and an answer 'I want you to...' for each imperative sentence.

Written exercises C: Rewrite with negative infinitives

Rewrite these sentences. Example: Don't type it again! (He/her) → He is telling her not to type it again. He doesn't want her to type it again.

模仿例句改写以下句子，注意不定式的否定形式。例句：不要重打！(他/她) → 他在告诉她不要重打。他不想让她重打。

Convert each negative imperative sentence to two statements using 'tell/want + object + not to + verb'.

Written exercises D: Answer the questions

Answer these questions. Example: Why is he speaking to her? (type it again) → Because he doesn't want her to type it again.

模仿例句回答以下问题。例句：他为什么在跟她说话？(重打) → 因为他不想让她重打。

Answer each question using 'Because + subject + doesn't want + object + to + verb'.

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

Practice A: What do you want me to do?

Re-write the sentences like the example to use I want / I don't want ... to do in place of You / She / He / They must / mustn't ...

模仿例句用 I want / I don't want ... to do 来改写以下句子。

Convert each 'must/mustn't' sentence to an 'I want/I don't want...to' sentence. Item 1 is a printed example.

Practice B: Tell him to ... / Tell him not to ...

Read what the boss thinks and write what he asks his assistant to tell other people.

读出老板所想，写出老板让他的助手转告大家的事情。

Convert each 'must/mustn't' sentence to a 'Tell him/her/them to/not to...' sentence. Item 1 is a printed example.

Practice C: Situations

Read these situations. What do you say in each?

读以下情境。在每种情况下你会说什么？

Complete each situation with an appropriate response using 'I want/I don't want...to' or 'Tell him/her/them to/not to...'.

03

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATION

Grammar 语法练习

Grammar I: Rewrite with 'I want/I don't want + object + to + verb'

Rewrite the sentences, using the words given according to the example. Example: Shut the door, not the window. (you) → I want you to shut the door. I don't want you to shut the window.

仿照例句用所给的词改写下列句子。例句：关上门，不要关上窗。（你）→ 我要你关上门。我不要你关上窗。

Rewrite each imperative sentence using 'I want/I don't want + object + to + verb'. Item 1 is a printed example.

Grammar II: Rewrite with 'tell + object + to/not to + verb'

Rewrite the sentences, using the words given according to the example. Example: Be careful. Don't make any mistakes. (him) → Tell him to be careful. Tell him not to make any mistakes.

仿照例句用所给的词改写下列句子。例句：小心。不要犯错误。（他）→ 叫他小心。叫他不要犯错误。

Rewrite each pair of sentences using 'tell + object + to/not to + verb'. Item 1 is a printed example.
